text.title: 会造梦的人
text.body: 一个老板能让很多人愿意跟随他，绝不是因为他在某个技术上有多厉害，|而是他善于给别人构建梦想，让别人对他构建的梦想有期待，有盼头。|这不是说要宣扬行骗，而是当我们掌握这种给别人“造梦”的能力和思维时，|只要把它用到积极正向的事情上，是可以给予人动力，鼓舞和希望的。
text.en: A boss can make many people willing to follow him, not because he is exceptionally skilled in some technique, but because he is good at building dreams for others, giving them something to expect and to look forward to. This is not to advocate deception; rather, when we master this ability and way of thinking of building dreams for others, as long as we apply it to positive things, it can give people motivation, inspiration, and hope.
text.credit: 原作 弗里德里希《雾海上的旅人》约1818年 · 德国浪漫主义布面油画 · 冷雾灰暖褐
